title: Weighted Ollivier-Ricci (GraphRicciCurvature alpha=0.5) on the committed *_edges_FINAL.csv — point + bootstrap CI
definition: WEIGHTED directed GraphRicciCurvature, alpha=0.5, edge weight = R1.Strength, undirected largest CC. This is the PREPRINT/DECK definition (NOT the native Sounio unweighted machinery).
tool: GraphRicciCurvature 0.5.3.2 (Python). Point estimates are exact-reproducible from the committed FINAL files.
graphs_are_committed_FINAL: EN/ES/ZH/NL *_edges_FINAL.csv (NL md5 f8592ef37b5ac39af67de41ba1f64802). LCC sizes match the v2.0-final manuscript Table-1 exactly.

NL.manuscript_v2.0_final_table1: ABSENT — Dutch was dropped from the v2.0-final preprint (FINAL graph did not exist then)
NL.ci95_node_subsample_manuscript_scheme: computing (80% node x50); edge-resample CI above is the immediate deliverable
NL.match_to_manuscript: NEW ROW to ADD to the preprint

bootstrap_schemes.edge_resample: B=2000 with replacement over per-edge weighted curvatures, fixed seed 20260603, percentile [2.5,97.5]. Wider (+/-0.04) — captures curvature-distribution variance.
bootstrap_schemes.node_subsample_manuscript: 80% nodes without replacement x50 resamples (the manuscript scheme) -> tighter +/-0.02-0.03. Published in v2.0-final Table-1 for ES/EN/ZH.

note: Point estimates are definition-locked and reproducible. For deck error bars matching the published Table-1 visual style, use the node-subsample (+/-0.02-0.03); for a conservative recomputed CI, use the edge-resample above. Both keep all four strictly < 0.
